# @bridge-ui/react

> React component library. Design tokens and utils come from transitive `@bridge-ui/core`.

## Setup

```bash
npm install @bridge-ui/react
npx bridge-ui-react-ai install
```

## AI resources (this package)

- ai/AGENTS.md
- ai/llms.txt
- ai/guidelines/core.md
- ai/skills/bridge-ui-setup/SKILL.md
- ai/skills/bridge-ui-components/SKILL.md
- ai/skills/bridge-ui-forms/SKILL.md
- ai/skills/bridge-ui-overlays/SKILL.md

After install in an app, these are linked as:

- AGENTS.md / .ai/AGENTS.md
- llms.txt
- .ai/guidelines/
- .cursor/skills/bridge-ui-*

## Imports

- `@bridge-ui/react`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Components/{Name}`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Provider`
- `@bridge-ui/react/Actions`
- `@bridge-ui/react/theme.css`
